cta: The company or the rules: who should have stopped Titan? Comment

facts.label: Day of June of the implosion
People on board, all of whom died
Depth of Titan when its last message (dropping two weights) was received, metres
Seconds between Titan's final message and the implosion (Coast Guard report)
Water pressure at the depth of the Titanic wreck site, pounds per square inch
Nominal thickness of the carbon fibre cylinder, inches

references.what: Titan big in blue water with a yellow arrow and a two-line question

thumbnail.pattern: the Titan hits show the submersible itself big in dark blue water with a few bold words; ours shows our 3D Titan sinking with its lamps on and the last message bubble beside it, two words on top

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Titan's last message was routine. Then it went silent.

place: black water above the Titanic wreck, Titan sinking with its lamps on
the text link on the sub's own console

moments.what: Titan sinking through black water, lamps on, snow drifting up past it; date caption and the reconstruction tag; TITAN label types on
a green text bubble rises from the sub: DROPPED TWO WTS, the depth readout beside it
push in: a green tick stamps ROUTINE on the bubble as two steel weights fall away from the frame into the dark
the weights' trail of bubbles streams up past the lamps
pull wide: the sound ring around the sub stops, the bubble's cursor blinks red, NO REPLY

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It was {fact4} metres down, near the Titanic. So what happened?

params.place: a cut-through of the North Atlantic, from the ship on the surface down to the seabed

moments.what: the depth ruler draws down the sea, the sub's green dot slides down it to its depth tag, a dashed trail behind it
the depth tag lands beside the dot, the sea bands SUNLIGHT ENDS and TOTAL DARKNESS light up on the ruler
the camera drops toward the seabed, the gap bracket between the dot and the bottom pulses
the broken bow of the Titanic draws on in green line, TITANIC
push in on the dot: it turns grey, a question mark blinks beside it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: On the ship, the crew typed a reply. Then another. No answer.

params.place: the operations room on the support ship, the tracking screen glowing in the dark

moments.what: the operations room: a crew member at the console under the big tracking screen, OPERATIONS · SUPPORT SHIP
the crew member leans in to the keyboard
keys flash, a reply bubble types on: SHIP: ACK
a second bubble types on: SHIP: LOST TRACKING
the sub's side stays empty, a red cursor blinks, NO SIGNAL stamps over the depth bar

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: At the Titanic's depth, the sea presses {fact6} pounds on every square inch.

params.place: close on the hull's carbon skin, one square inch drawn on it, the water pressing in

moments.what: the curved black carbon skin of the hull fills the frame, dark water above it
water arrows close in from every side
the pressure gauge's needle swings to the figure, its readout counts up
the readout flashes, the water arrows press in harder on the hull
a one-inch square outlines in amber on the skin, ONE SQUARE INCH
a stack of arrows presses down on that one square, then the camera pulls back: the whole hull ringed by arrows

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Holding it back: a carbon fibre tube, {fact7} inches thick.

params.place: beside Titan in the dark, its white fairing cut away to show the pressure hull

moments.what: Titan in the dark, the camera circling it
the white fairing cuts away to show the black carbon cylinder inside, CARBON FIBRE types on
push along the tube's black wall
a readout plate with the wall's thickness slides on as the camera pulls back past the titanium domes

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: But investigators found that wall was likely already damaged, its layers coming apart.

params.place: inside the hull's wall, a cross-section of the carbon layers on a green instrument screen

moments.what: a cross-section of the wall draws on: five stacked carbon layers, SAFETY BOARD FINDING
a scan line sweeps across the layers
one patch turns amber, LIKELY DAMAGED stamps on
a gap opens between two layers
the gap spreads along the wall and turns red
the layers peel apart at the edge, the pressure arrows push into the gap

params.place: at Titan's flank in the black water, time slowed

moments.what: silence: the carbon hull fills the frame in the black water, its wall glowing amber to red under the lamps
the sub-boom: the wall buckles in one spot and the hull collapses inward in a white flash
wide: a cloud of debris and bubbles spreads in the dark, the lamps gone

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: {fact5} seconds after that message, the hull imploded. All {fact3} aboard died.

params.place: far out in the dark water where Titan was, the debris settling toward the seabed

moments.what: a clock readout counts the seconds from the message
the last message bubble DROPPED TWO WTS floats beside it, greyed
the debris cloud drifts slowly down in the dark
five small lit figures, one for each person aboard, stand in a row
the five figures' lights go out one by one, only the snow drifting

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The company or the rules: who should have stopped Titan? Full story on our channel, from its last message.

place: on the surface by the support ship at dawn, Titan on its launch platform
back down in the black water as the first frame

moments.what: dawn on the grey North Atlantic: Titan on its platform, the support ship far off; THE COMPANY chip types on
OR THE RULES? types on beside it
the platform sinks and Titan slips under the surface
FULL STORY ON THE CHANNEL types on
back to the first frame: Titan sinking in the black with its lamps on
